english.note: Use this when someone is officially named to a post or role.
Use this for formally appointing someone to an office or official position.

examples.english: The board will appoint him as the new principal.
examples.traditional: 董事會任命佢做新校長。

examples.english: The government will formally assign him to the post of director.
